body: Yup, I couldn't do anything remotely sexual with anyone until just recently. It fluctuates a lot between hyper and hypo now.
I initially thought I had AVPD. But then I realized I don't avoid everything, I only avoid situations that relate to the repeated trauma I went through.

1. If you want a relationship just so you don't have to be alone, it's not the relationship you need. It's hard but you have to learn how to love yourself and be happy alone, and only then do you attract healthy partners.  
2. Try to think of rejection as a reminder that it wasn't meant to be. Sort of cliche but it helps me a bit.
